answer.justification: Only logit-level measurements are available. KL 0.039 sits at the bottom of the quantized range (0.039–0.071) and below the fine-tuned (0.081–0.205) and system-prompted (0.197–0.339) ranges. Top-1 agreement 0.957 is slightly above the quantized range (0.945–0.955) but far above the fine-tuned and system-prompted ranges. Sequence agreement 0.688 falls within the quantized 0.67–0.70 range, and the Token-DiFR gap 0.037 matches the quantized 0.03–0.04. TV 0.040 is slightly under the quantized 0.048–0.055. Base is ruled out because every value is non-zero. Fine-tuned is the closest alternative, but its KL and DiFR gap are noticeably larger. The raw-score shift ÷ TV of 2.8 sits between the quantized (2.2–2.3) and system-prompted (3.3–3.9) ranges and does not separate the categories well.
